scientific_summary: Oral sildenafil did not establish tested primary benefit in the two specified dystrophinopathy studies. Witting secondary ND rows are not tested nulls; Leung cardiac-worsening and registry-safety comparisons have mixed, overlapping exposure periods and imprecise causal interpretation.

exact_prior_decision.route: sildenafil / prior-cell-exposure and AR-12 chaperone-combination comparison
exact_prior_decision.disposition: Source-specific cellular pretreatment and combination comparator; defer MVA promotion
exact_prior_decision.evidence_scope: Booth Oncotarget 2016: separately attributed complete main/caption review and native Figure 13; cellular combination functional findings have main-text-only supplemental depth. Sildenafil salt, formulation and clinical-equivalent exposure are unresolved.
exact_prior_decision.rationale: GBM12 cells expressing tagged HSP90 or HSP70 receive sildenafil 2 µM for 1 h before immunoprecipitation. Equal isolated bead portions then receive AR-12 or comparators at 30–1000 nM ex vivo. Baseline complex activities are near unchanged after sildenafil pretreatment, while AR-12 inhibition is enhanced. This is prior cellular exposure, not a demonstrated direct sildenafil-binding or purified-enzyme inhibition experiment; associated proteins may contribute to activity. Potentiation differs by compound and chaperone, including distinct pazopanib/regorafenib results. Tumor-cell imaging also tests sildenafil 2 µM with AR-12; antibody-signal changes are not protein-loss or ATPase proof. Main text reports enhanced tumor killing in combination, including the separate AR-13 result, but original supplemental functional plots/captions, exact exposure contrasts and formal additivity-model synergy remain unqualified. Genetic chaperone/thioredoxin protection is not an administered restorative treatment. No direct current-paper non-transformed comparison, therapeutic margin, BUBR1 restoration, healthy-tissue renewal or MVA benefit is established.

source_qualification.role: Later human dystrophinopathy source qualification for an append/refinement; preserve earlier AR-12 cancer/chaperone interpretation and its independent exposure limits. No actual ledger change.

sources.title: Effect of sildenafil on skeletal and cardiac muscle in Becker muscular dystrophy
sources.source_depth: Complete abstract, retained primary PDF-reader text L0@P0 through L371@P5, ending at first SF36 Table 3 row. Not full 8-page main or native figures/tables. Direct public PDF is now 404; advertised supplement 403. Current registry read.

sources.title: Sildenafil Does Not Improve Cardiomyopathy in Duchenne/Becker Muscular Dystrophy
sources.source_depth: Complete scientific main through public NCBI BioC representation plus PMC web-reader funding/COI; original table XML and all 3 native figures read. Native main PDF/table pixels and supplement not obtained. Current registry including posted results read.
sources.version: PMC author-manuscript representation of 2014 publication, not a newly verified final publisher PDF. BioC year 2015 reflects repository metadata, not a new trial.

design.setting: Single-center Copenhagen, Denmark, December 2011–January 2013; recruitment December 2011–November 2012
design.population: Adult ambulatory genetically/Western-blot-confirmed BMD, reduced EF<50% and/or skeletal weakness MRC<5 in paper Table 1; mean age 38, variable severity. Current registry uses MRC<4+ and age 18–80; thresholds are not silently harmonized.
design.randomization: Independent pharmacist, computer-generated blocks of 4, 2:2 active/placebo sequence, no stratification; identical capsules/containers
design.treatment_periods: Two 4-week periods with 2-week intervening washout and 2-week final follow-up
design.cardiac_nonparticipants: Two claustrophobia and one transplanted heart
design.ITT_limit: Authors call intention-to-treat but exclude one randomized participant with no postmedication data; do not claim all 17 analyzed.
design.missingness: 8/256 data points partly/completely missing. Four missing baseline observations replaced using other baseline; remaining missing observations retained as missing in ANOVA. Cardiac MRI had only one baseline because of availability.
design.power: No conventional prospective power calculation; reasoned 12 completers, target 20, stopped 17 because eligible subjects exhausted. Table 2 reported power is not equivalence evidence.
design.carryover_period_limit: Washout used, but no formal sequence/period/carryover estimates are shown in the retained methods; do not infer proven absence of carryover.

exposure.paper: 20 mg tablets enclosed with placebo in identical capsules; taken 1 hour before evaluation;12 hour nicotine/caffeine abstention
exposure.current_registry: 20 mg in gelatine capsules; placebo lactose monohydrate in gelatine capsules three times daily
exposure.brand_limit: Registry experimental label prints Revation, with Revatio appearing under the placebo otherNames field; otherNames are cross-assigned. Do not use these fields as clean alias equivalence or batch proof.
exposure.salt_batch_excipient_equivalence: Exact active salt, manufacturer batch and full excipients not established by accessible primary text; no current retail equivalence.

hierarchy.skeletal_primary: Brachial artery blood flow during maximal handgrip
hierarchy.registry_limit: Current NCT record calls resting LVEDV cardiac primary and exercise cardiac function secondary; also includes cognitive/cerebrovascular substudy endpoints. Historical field versions/SAP not read, so exact prespecified exercise-CO hierarchy is unresolved.

blood_flow.locator: Retained Table 2 L235@P3, footnote active versus placebo L262
blood_flow.interpretation: Exercise flow increased after both periods relative to baseline; no demonstrated sildenafil-placebo effect. No confidence interval for treatment difference available.

resting_LVEDV.change_columns_not_corrected: Retained parser prints 2 and 1; do not silently assign missing minus sign.

exercise_CO.reason: Malformed retained PDF extraction requires unavailable native-table verification; do not repair 72,263 or change columns by inference.

analysis_limit.method: One-way repeated-measures ANOVA for primary measures; secondary means visually inspected and ANOVA only when significance suspected. Authors state 4 ANOVAs total, no multiplicity correction.
analysis_limit.ND_interpretation: No inferential P supplied; these rows are not formally tested nulls. Remaining SF36 subcategories and identity/result of any fourth ANOVA are not established from truncated Table 3.
analysis_limit.reported_significance_text: A significance level of <0.05% was applied, resulting in a risk of type 1 error of 0.95.
analysis_limit.qualification: Mathematically inconsistent as retained. Native PDF unavailable to distinguish source typo from extraction corruption; not silently replaced with alpha .05 or risk .05.
analysis_limit.reviewer_bound: Tested primary results did not demonstrate benefit; reported descriptive nonresponse is not universal zero-effect/equivalence evidence.

mechanism.uncertainty_statistic: Retained text does not identify SD versus SE here; no relabeling.
mechanism.target_availability_limit: All 5 reported reduced nNOS/PDE5; no native Western blot inspection. Small selected baseline biopsy subset, not a randomized treatment change or demonstrated mediator of response.
mechanism.muscle_MRI_context: Two illustrative patients 14/17; no treatment-induced tissue renewal finding.

harms_and_other_positive_reports.serious_AEs: None reported in abstract; detailed full supplement not read.
harms_and_other_positive_reports.symptomatic: Dyspepsia/headache reported by 5 during sildenafil; 1 headache on placebo; no separate count per symptom inferred.
harms_and_other_positive_reports.erectile_reports: Four volunteered improved erectile function during sildenafil and none placebo. Not systematically solicited to preserve blinding; not a prespecified functional-muscle benefit or proof of muscle target engagement.

witting2014.disclosure: Final funding/author COI section unavailable in retained partial main. Current registry academic sponsor/collaborator does not substitute for disclosure verification.

design.setting: Single-center Kennedy Krieger/Johns Hopkins, enrollment September 2010–February 2013
design.population: Adult males with dystrophinopathy and cardiomyopathy;18 DMD / 2 BMD randomized. Initial DMD-only age ≥15,EF ≤45%; amended to include BMD andEF ≤50%, later age ≥18; no minor had enrolled before age amendment.
design.background: Stable ACE inhibitor/ARB required≥3 months; beta-blocker/corticosteroid dose stable if used.
design.exposure: Oral sildenafil 20 mg tablet three times daily versus identical white placebo tablets for 6 months, then planned 6 months open-label sildenafil in both groups.
design.source_product: REVERSE-DBMD/Revatio; Pfizer supplied sildenafil and matching placebo through Investigator-Initiated Research award. Exact batch, salt/excipients and current retail equivalence not verified.
design.blinded_discontinuations_active: One death,one withdrawal,one administrative study closure
design.analysis: Per-protocol complete 6-month MRI, age/baseline-adjusted regression; no imputation. Longitudinal random-effects analyses for repeated FVC/grip/pinch are separate.
design.interim: Planned review at half target enrollment; actual DSMB review after 15 completed 6 months; early termination. No full SAP/original protocol/historical registry audit.

baseline_imbalance.interpretation: Active arm more severe at baseline on these measures despite randomization; small sample and completion selection limit causal precision.

primary.endpoint: Six-month change in LVESV,mL; lower is better
primary.interpretation: No statistically established treatment difference; direction did not show anticipated improvement. Printed estimate/CI are retained without recalculation; apparent interval issue flagged.
primary.locator: Main Table 2, original table XML/BioC and PMC reader

cardiac_worsening_signal.endpoint: ≥10% LVESV increase during first 6 months of sildenafil exposure
cardiac_worsening_signal.overlap: Some placebo participants later contribute sildenafil exposure; main says 8 of 14 previously received placebo. Do not silently reconcile this statement with native 6/7 twelve-month completion counts.
cardiac_worsening_signal.interpretation: Clinically consequential safety signal led to DSMB termination, with very imprecise estimate and baseline-severity confounding; not proven causal harm, MVA harm, or class-wide harm.

other_results.quality_of_life: Authors report no statistically significant SF36v2/INQoL domain differences after baseline/age adjustment; detailed supplement unavailable.
other_results.within_sildenafil_FVC: Reported decline 0.06 L over 6 months, 95% CI [−.130,−.013],P = .011 in longitudinal model. This is a within-exposure time trend, not the randomized between-group FVC contrast.
other_results.baseline_severity: Baseline LVESV≥120 mL associated with later worsening regardless of treatment,P = .035; not validated drug-by-severity interaction.
other_results.futility: Authors extrapolate low likelihood of reaching intended 10% effect using assumed future responses. Their stated 1.75×10^-7 is a conditional calculation, not a new independently rerun analysis or proof of no possible benefit at all exposures.
other_results.fibrosis: Incomplete DCE imaging, qualitative enhancement; no randomized repair or renewal result.

harms.main: One heart-failure death during blinded sildenafil phase, judged unlikely related by DSMB. AEs detailed in unavailable SupplementaryTable 1; no claim of no other events.
harms.registry_serious_terms: Sildenafil-labelled group: heart-failure death,dehydration,pneumonia,prostate infection,gastroparesis (one each). Placebo-labelled group:fecal impaction(one).
harms.registry_other_examples: Low blood pressure 4/18 versus 0/10; headache 1/18 versus 2/10; all exact terms retained in saved registry.
harms.registry_limit: Exposure counts 18/10 exceed randomized 10/10 and include crossover/open-label exposure; do not present these as simple randomized 6-month rates or infer event causality. Time-window metadata not explicit enough to resolve each event period.

leung2014.disclosure: Patient foundations funded the trial and travel; NIH/NCATS institutional clinical/translational support is acknowledged. Pfizer provided drug/placebo. Sponsors proposed idea and received DSMB reports; authors state design/conduct/analysis/publication independent. DPJ Pfizer/Array/Onyx consulting; KRW multiple industry consultancies and honoraria; DAK patent 20090062313 disclosed.
reporting_problems: PMC/BioC Table 2 primary effect 6.99 with printed CI [−.81,23.77] lacks expected centering; no statistical reconstruction.

FVC printed CI [.17,.20] excludes point 0.01 and conflicts with nonsignificant P = .863; pinch printed CI [.73,.37] is reversed and excludes −0.18. Native final-PDF table unavailable; do not silently insert minus signs or 9.
Table 1 complete-case baseline LVESV active 105.2 / placebo 84 differs from Table 2 active 107.49 / placebo 84.28; preserve table attribution.
Main describes 14 sildenafil exposures with 8 prior placebo recipients; native Figure 1 shows 7/8 six-month and 6/7 twelve-month completers. No participant-level reconciliation.
DCE denominator counts differ from efficacy/completer counts; no universal denominator applied.

tadalafil_positive.identity: Martin EA, Barresi R, Byrne BJ et al. Tadalafil alleviates muscle ischemia in patients with Becker muscular dystrophy. Sci Transl Med 2012;4:162ra155.
tadalafil_positive.attribution: The cited BMD physiology positive belongs to tadalafil, not sildenafil. It does not transfer clinical efficacy to sildenafil or all PDE5 inhibitors.
tadalafil_positive.reading_depth: Citation/attribution only; full primary trial not independently qualified here.
tadalafil_positive.bibliographic_limit: Witting reference14 reports4:162ra155; Leung reference18 has malformed volume/page metadata(28(162):162ra55). Identity and tadalafil attribution agree; no new trial appraisal.

cerebral_companion.scope: Optional same-program context only; no valid main obtained from attempted public routes, no scientific reading or independent replication credit. Current Witting registry already documents cognitive/cerebrovascular substudy endpoints.

other_sources.other_PDE5_studies: Not freshly reviewed; no comprehensive class conclusion.

comparative_scope.function: No demonstrated skeletal functional benefit in these sildenafil trials; Witting secondaries largely untested and Leung small complete-case contrasts imprecise. Do not equate insufficient evidence with universalzero effect.
comparative_scope.exposure: Two oral 20 mg three-times-daily regimens with different durations/populations; neither proves equivalence to AR-12 cellular 2 µM pretreatment.
comparative_scope.target_availability: Witting 5-biopsy nNOS/PDE5 deficit is a possible local target-availability limitation, not demonstrated response mediation.
comparative_scope.renewal_and_fidelity: Neither establishes healthy muscle renewal, chromosome segregation fidelity, BUBR1 restoration or MVA benefit.
comparative_scope.fair_bar: Same function/exposure/durability/renewal/fidelity criteria as other compensation comparisons; BUBR1 mediation additionally needed only for restoration.

source_qualification.source_specific_disposition: Human dystrophinopathy comparison for existing sildenafil: tested primary nonbenefit, Witting untested-secondary/access limits, and Leung imprecise cardiac-worsening signal. Defer MVA promotion; no global ineffectiveness or harm claim.

historical_metadata_notice: The nested source qualification is the exact frozen historical object, including its pending-review label and 037570fc/275 identity checkpoint. Separate independent ACCEPT and current c61fc087/276 proposal context are recorded here; historical scientific fields were not rewritten.

source_provenance.raw_assets: Retained externally in the named source archive; no original primary PDFs, raw XML, registry payloads or native images are copied into this portable export.

reading_attribution.source_and_independent_depth: Witting: complete retained abstract/partial primary excerpt through L371@P5, with no full-main/native/supplement claim. Leung: complete scientific BioC/PMC main, original table XML, three native figures and relevant current registry; native main PDF/table pixels and supplement unavailable.
reading_attribution.portable_synthesis: Accepted qualifications, independent reviews, immutable ledger and targeted document passages read. No new primary-source or native-panel reading at this stage.
reading_attribution.earlier_studies: Old source-specific reading depth is preserved; citations and inherited rationale confer no new reading credit.

interpretive_boundaries: Separate preparations, populations, exercise/background treatment and durations; no pooled efficacy or generic retail equivalence.
No MVA efficacy, genotype rescue, healthy-tissue renewal or chromosome-fidelity claim.
Compensation evidence receives the same function, exposure, durability, renewal and fidelity criteria; BUBR1 mediation additionally applies to restoration claims.
No universal sildenafil/PDE5 ineffectiveness or proven MVA/clinical causal-harm inference.
Oral trial exposure is not equated with the earlier AR-12 cellular 2 µM pretreatment.
